design_philosophy: Premium Caribbean dining. Let the vibrant food and elegant interior imagery shine against a warm Cream White background. Use Black for sharp typographic contrast, Deep Orange for appetite-inducing CTAs, Tropical Green for lush structural accents, and Gold for high-end borders/highlights.

typography.guidelines: Do not center align everything. Use left alignment for body copy to enhance reading rhythm. Headings should be sophisticated, not chunky.

layout.spacing: Use p-8 to p-16 for internal containers. Section gaps should be massive (py-24 or py-32) to give the layout breathing room.
layout.grid: Bento-style grids for the 'Popular Dishes' and 'Menu Highlights'. Mix col-span-2 and col-span-1 to create an asymmetrical, editorial gallery feel.
layout.hero_overlay: Use a subtle gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-black/60 via-black/30 to-transparent) over the hero image so the white text and gold accents remain legible without muddying the image.

components.header: Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF8F5]/85). Include a subtle 1px bottom border in gold/green tint (border-[#D4AF37]/30). Sticky positioned.

buttons.primary: Solid Deep Orange (bg-[#D84315]) with white text. Hover state slightly darker (#BF360C) with a subtle lift (-translate-y-0.5).
buttons.secondary: Transparent with 1px solid border in Gold (#D4AF37) or Green (#1B5E20), colored text. Hover state fills the background with a 5% opacity tint.
buttons.rules: Buttons should have moderate border radius (rounded-md). Always set text color on hover.

components.cards: Avoid default Shadcn card borders. Use flat, borderless layouts with high-quality images. Use a subtle shadow-sm only on hover.
components.images: All standard images should have rounded-xl or rounded-2xl to feel organic, except edge-to-edge banners.

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for bento grid items and menu lists.
motion.scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling via Lenis. Subtle parallax on background imagery.

hero.description: Elegant warm restaurant interior for the main hero background.

food_showcase.description: Jerk chicken with plantains and rice.

about_catering.description: Warm lit tropical foliage dining setup for catering/events section.
Tropical fine dining interior with plants.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided. DO NOT use generic blue or purple. The entire vibe is Cream, Black, Orange, Green, and Gold.
Implement a clear bilingual Language Switcher (FR/EN) in the Header.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the landing page layout to achieve the asymmetrical, editorial look.
Use Shadcn UI for interactive forms (Contact Form, Reservations/Ordering Modals) but strip their default borders to match the premium theme.
Hero section must include multiple CTAs: 'Order Online', 'View Menu', 'Call Now'.
Include a Click-to-Call floating/fixed action button for mobile viewports.
Use 'lucide-react' for all icons (e.g., Phone, MapPin, Star).
All interactive elements MUST have role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='lang-switcher', data-testid='cta-order-hero').
Do NOT use placeholder images. Use the exact URLs provided in the media section.
Ensure high contrast on all text overlays; use text-shadow or gradient scrims if necessary.
Ensure mobile-first responsiveness across all bento grids and typography scaling.
